title: Your first panel
intro: You just joined the on-call rotation. The team's dashboard is empty. Start by charting how many HTTP requests each service has served.
tutorial: Click "Add panel" at the top of the dashboard.
In the query box, type http_requests_total and press Ctrl+Enter to run it.
Click "Apply" to save the panel to the dashboard.

objectives.text: Add a time series panel that shows http_requests_total

hints: Use the "Add panel" button at the top right of the dashboard.
The query is just the metric name: http_requests_total
solution: Add panel → Time series → query: http_requests_total → Apply
debrief: Every Grafana panel is a query plus a visualization. Notice the lines only go up: http_requests_total is a counter, which is why you rarely graph it raw. You'll fix that with rate() in Chapter 2.
